scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @sdcorejs/chaos-ui build && pnpm --filter @sdcorejs/chaos-ui-react build && pnpm --filter @sdcorejs/chaos-ui-angular build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @chaos-ui/playground build && pnpm --filter @chaos-ui/example-react build && pnpm --filter @chaos-ui/example-angular build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.check.json && pnpm --filter @chaos-ui/example-angular typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:pack && pnpm test:e2e
